extracted.intended_audience: media organizations and credentialed individuals (journalists, photographers, broadcasters, press agencies) seeking NFL game/event credentials
extracted.subtask_description: Terms and conditions governing issuance and permitted uses of 2023 NFL credential cards, including permitted editorial uses, prohibitions (video/streaming/play-by-play/commercial use), safety/waiver provisions, and dispute/governing-law clauses for Accredited Organizations and individual Bearers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Binding Agreement / Acceptance
rubrics_metrics.description: Acceptance of credentialed access to a Game or Event constitutes agreement by the Accredited Organization and the Bearer to be bound by the Credential Use Conditions, the referenced Credentials2023.pdf terms, any required executed 2023 Arbitration and Release and Liability Waiver Form (if required by the host Club), and the NFL Official Rule Book governing access to the playing field area, as well as any other rules issued by or on behalf of the NFL and/or Member Clubs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acceptance binds both the Accredited Organization and the individual Bearer to the listed documents and any additional rules issued by NFL Entities or Member Clubs. The Credential Use Conditions are intended to be enforceable by NFL Entities as third-party beneficiaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose and Non-Transferability of Credential
rubrics_metrics.description: The credential card provides privileged and revocable access to an Accredited Organization for the sole purpose of authorizing access to a designated stadium/facility or Game/Event for a Bearer who is working for, or on behalf of, the Accredited Organization and has a legitimate working function at the Game/Event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Credential may not be transferred by the Bearer or the Accredited Organization; the Bearer may use it only directly for or on behalf of the Accredited Organization for permitted purposes. Unauthorized use can lead to ejection, criminal trespass prosecution, and revocation of future credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revocation Rights
rubrics_metrics.description: A League Entity or the applicable Member Club, at its sole discretion, may revoke any Accredited Organization’s or individual Bearer’s credentials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Revocation can be exercised by League Entities, Member Clubs, their agents and employees; NFL Entities are intended third-party beneficiaries with full rights to enforce terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permitted Uses — News and Editorial Coverage Only
rubrics_metrics.description: The credential card authorizes use by the Accredited Organization only, solely for news and editorial coverage purposes, of descriptions, accounts, film, video or digital still images from the Game/Event, or of player/personnel interviews, press conferences or other related activities (collectively, 'Game and Event Material'), and limited use of NFL Entity logos or trademarks ('Marks') in connection with those uses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Permitted uses include production and distribution of Game and Event Material for news/editorial purposes, and limited use of Marks only in connection with authorized editorial uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-Party Licensing/Distribution Restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: An Accredited Organization may license and distribute Game and Event Materials to third parties for news and editorial coverage only if (i) the Accredited Organization is an established news wire or photo-licensing service, (ii) such licensing/distribution is in its ordinary course of business, and (iii) it contractually requires third parties to use materials solely for news and editorial coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any other distribution/licensing to third parties (other than ultimate consumers) is expressly prohibited unless advance written permission is obtained from the applicable League Entity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibited Uses — Non-Editorial and Certain Third-Party Distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Any other use or attempted use by the Bearer or Accredited Organization of Game and Event Material or Marks is expressly prohibited unless advance written permission is obtained. Prohibited uses include (without limitation) (x) distribution or licensing to third parties other than ultimate consumers, (y) authorization of any third party to redistribute Game and Event Material (e.g., play-by-play data feeds), and (z) any non-editorial use of Game and Event Material or Marks, including in connection with commercial products or services (e.g., daily fantasy sports contests, sports betting, apparel, posters, commemorative programs, souvenir merchandise, or sponsored content).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prohibited uses are broad and include commercial exploitation, data feed redistribution, and uses that would monetize or repurpose content outside news/editorial contexts. Advance written permission is required for exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on Providing Third-Party Brand Exposure at Game/Event
rubrics_metrics.description: While at the Game/Event, the Accredited Organization and Bearer are prohibited from providing exposure to any third-party brand(s) (e.g., marks, logos) for commercial, marketing or publicity purposes including through exposure of third-party brands on apparel, accessories or equipment worn or used by Bearer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any on-site appearance that gives promotional exposure to third-party brands is prohibited and can subject Bearer and Accredited Organization to sanctions.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Media Supplement Conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Accredited Organizations may supplement traditional media distribution with other new media platforms they control (websites, official social media accounts, apps, podcasts) provided certain limits: (i) film/video/digital still images are limited to a reasonable amount and used only to illustrate/support news/editorial coverage; (ii) not used to create Simulated Video of game action; (iii) no video of game action is used (except for specified television broadcaster online simulcast limits); and (iv) non-game audio/video obtained via credentialed access (press conferences, training camp, practice, interviews) must be limited to 90 seconds max per day (180 seconds in two-Member Club markets), not posted/streamed live or archived beyond 24 hours, appear only in editorial context, and include links back to NFL.com and the applicable Member Club's website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New media use is allowed but tightly constrained: short, non-live editorial snippets only, with explicit linking back requirements; broadcasters have narrow exceptions for simulcast highlights under separate limits. 'Reasonable amount' and time limits are enforced; exceeding them requires separate permission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate License Required for Uses Exceeding Limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Any proposed use of Game and Event Material that is more detailed and/or immediate than described herein or which exceeds the stated limits, and any exceptions to prohibitions, requires a separate license from the applicable League Entity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact the applicable League Entity to request a specific license; do not presume any use beyond these terms is allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Game Video Content Subject to Video Highlights License
rubrics_metrics.description: Game video content (including all game action and all ancillary on-field activities occurring inside the stadium on gameday) may be used only in accordance with the 2023 NFL Video Highlights License, which is attached and available at NFLcommunications.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the 2023 NFL Video Highlights License for detailed terms and permissible uses of game video; this credential alone does not authorize most game video uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio Highlights Limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Game audio content ('Audio Highlights') is subject to limits: (a) may only be used as part of regularly scheduled news programs that include news/sports/weather or regular sports wrap-up shows that cover all sports; (b) no Audio Highlights from games in progress; (c) on game days, up to two minutes of Audio Highlights from any one game that day may be used but no more than six minutes total from all games that day; (d) on non-game days, up to one minute from any one game in the preceding six days may be used but no more than two minutes total from all games in the preceding six days; and (e) Audio Highlights may not be used in connection with or associated with any third party (e.g., a sponsor).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strict time and contextual limits apply to use of game audio; breaches (e.g., using audio in sponsored content) are prohibited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligation to Prevent and Respond to Unauthorized Third-Party Use
rubrics_metrics.description: The Accredited Organization shall use reasonable efforts to (i) prevent the unauthorized and/or infringing use of Game and Event Material by third parties and (ii) promptly take action against any such unauthorized and/or infringing use that is brought to the Accredited Organization’s attention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Credential holders must actively police downstream misuse (e.g., require contractual restrictions of licensees and pursue takedowns or other remedies when infringements arise).

rubrics_metrics.name: No Video of Game Content / Ban on Simulated Video
rubrics_metrics.description: Credential does not authorize the Bearer to create, use or transmit video, or to animate, sequence, loop or otherwise manipulate film or digital still images to appear to be video ('Simulated Video') of game content (including game action and ancillary on-field activities). Even if issued to video personnel, the credential only authorizes creation of video of non-Game activities (player interviews, press conferences). Creation of video of Game content from the sideline and/or areas close to the field requires a separate, signed Sideline/Close Proximity Video Access Agreement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not create or publish simulated video of game action; sideline/close-proximity game videography requires separate agreements and permissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: No Streaming During Game/Event
rubrics_metrics.description: Streaming of any Game and Event Materials while the Game is being played or the Event is occurring—in any form, medium, or duration—is prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Real-time or near-real-time streaming of content captured under credentialed access is forbidden; time-delayed and limited distribution only as described elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: No Play-by-Play or Statistical Account
rubrics_metrics.description: While a Game or Event is in progress, distribution of Game and Event Material must be time-delayed and/or limited in amount and may not, under any circumstances, involve, constitute, serve as a substitute for, or otherwise approximate, a play-by-play or statistical account or depiction of a Game or Event in any medium.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of acceptable limitations include score updates with detail only in quarterly game updates or providing fewer than 10 photographs during the game. Do not publish play-by-play text, live scoring streams, or detailed statistical play logs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assumption of Risk; COVID-19 Acknowledgement; Waiver and Indemnity
rubrics_metrics.description: The Accredited Organization and the Bearer understand and acknowledge risks (including personal injury and COVID-19) and knowingly and voluntarily assume all risks, hazards and dangers incident to the Game/Event. They agree that NFL Entities have no responsibility for equipment; they waive any and all claims related to such risks (except workers' compensation claims by Bearer against their employer) and agree to indemnify and hold harmless NFL Entities from and against all liability, loss, damage or expense resulting from issuance of the credential card or Bearer’s presence, except to the extent such liability arises out of willful or intentional misconduct of NFL Entities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bearers accept health and safety risks including COVID-19 exposure and related consequences; the waiver is broad and includes indemnity obligations toward NFL Entities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with NFL/Host/Facility Policies and Consent to Searches
rubrics_metrics.description: The Accredited Organization and Bearer agree they are not employees/agents of NFL Entities and agree to comply with all applicable policies of the NFL, the host club and the stadium/facility, including security, conduct, and health/safety policies. The Bearer and belongings may be searched upon entry and Bearer consents to such searches and waives related claims. Failure to consent to searches will result in denial of access.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comply with on-site policies and security procedures; noncompliance, disorderly conduct, or refusal of searches can lead to ejection, prosecution, and credential revocation for the Accredited Organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: No Entitlement to Damages on Refusal/Ejection/Revocation/Cancellation
rubrics_metrics.description: If admission is refused or withdrawn, Bearer is ejected, a credential card is revoked, or the Game/Event is canceled (regardless of replay/reschedule), or access modified, the Bearer and/or Accredited Organization will not be entitled to consequential, incidental, indirect, exemplary, or special damages of any kind.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary recovery for denied access or credential revocation is broadly disclaimed in the terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disputes — Mandatory Individual Arbitration and Class Waiver
rubrics_metrics.description: Any dispute, claim, or cause of action related to the credential card, the Credential Use Conditions, or Bearer’s presence at/ travel to/ provision of services at the Event shall be resolved by mandatory, confidential, final and binding arbitration in the city where the stadium/facility is located. All disputes shall be arbitrated on an individual basis; parties waive right to court/jury trial and to litigate or arbitrate any claim as a class action, representative action, or class arbitration. This clause is governed by the Federal Arbitration Act. If Accredited Organization or Bearer does not consent, Bearer must leave or not enter the stadium.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agreement to these terms includes a broad arbitration and class action waiver and requires arbitration in the stadium's city under FAA principles; nonconsent means no access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governing Law
rubrics_metrics.description: These Credential Use Conditions shall be governed by the laws of the state where the stadium or facility of the applicable Game or Event is located, without regard to choice of law principles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State law of the event location governs interpretation and enforcement, subject to the arbitration clause above.

rubrics_metrics.name: Severability
rubrics_metrics.description: If any provision of these Credential Use Conditions is determined to be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable, it shall be deemed severed and not affect enforceability of any other provisions, which shall be enforced as if the invalid provision did not exist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invalidity of one clause does not void the remainder of the agreement.
